$comment: Pages kept out of releases (the uat and main branches and their vX.Y.Z tags). stg publishes everything; `node scripts/release-scope.mjs apply` marks these pages status: draft on a release branch, and `validate.mjs --release` (CI on uat, main and release tags) fails if one is published there. An entry ending in '/' covers that folder and its overview page. Remove an entry when its product is released. A released page may not link to a hidden page (validate.mjs fails, on stg too) unless the entry has "links": "text": then the backend shows the link text only.

hide.why: Lab and metocean outputs not released
hide.linksWhy: binding cross-references in the Terms (6.4, 19.2), Privacy (12.3) and AUP; rewording them is a legal decision, so released pages show them as text
